title: tolvi doctor --json output
description: The machine-readable form of `tolvi doctor`. Setup checks only; the content scan has its own schema at vault-health.json. Check ids are stable across releases, so consumers key on id rather than on name, which is display text and may be reworded.

tolvi_version.description: The CLI that produced this output, as `tolvi version` reports it. 'dev' for an unreleased build. A consumer that needs a newer contract compares against this rather than parsing output it cannot trust.

ok.description: True when every check passed. Equivalent to the process exit code being zero, restated here so a consumer reading only stdout does not need it.

checks.description: One entry per setup assertion, in the order doctor runs them.

id.description: Stable identifier for the assertion. Adding a check adds a value here; renaming one is a breaking change to this contract.

name.description: Human-readable label, as the text report prints it. Display only.

detail.description: What was actually found, for example the resolved vault path or the binary location. May be empty.

fix.description: The command that repairs a failing check. Empty when the check passed.
